build_sharedmlp: build a SharedMLP module with a list of channel sizes, optional batch norm and activation
create_conv1d: create a 1D convolution layer with configurable kernel size, stride, padding, batch norm and activation
create_conv2d: create a 2D convolution layer with configurable kernel size, stride, padding, batch norm and activation
create_fc_layer: create a fully connected layer with optional batch norm, activation and preactivation ordering
test_bn_momentum_scheduler: test the BNMomentumScheduler to dynamically adjust batch norm momentum across training epochs
